name: cairn
title: Cairn
description: A charity theme printed like an orange survival bag: the mission and one impact figure in heavy black caps on safety orange, a heat-welded seam as the only rule, the mission as small print and the six-bar distress signal under it — orange ink on peat black at night.

tokens.--font-print: the one neo-grotesque family: heavy caps for headings, figures, labels and buttons; regular weight for the small print
tokens.--weight-heavy: boldness of the heavy caps — headings, the impact figure, labels, the menu and buttons
tokens.--weight-print: boldness of the small print: body text, the mission text, descriptions
tokens.--text-small: small print — labels, the menu, dates, prompts, the distress-signal caption, the footer
tokens.--text-body: body text and the mission text in the panel
tokens.--text-lede: the lede under a page title, quotations and the figures in a table's first column
tokens.--text-head: section headings, list titles and the unit beside the impact figure
tokens.--text-title: page titles and the mission headline
tokens.--text-stat: size of the impact figure, the one loud number
tokens.--leading-print: line height of the small print and body text
tokens.--leading-caps: line height of the heavy caps
tokens.--tracking-label: letter-spacing of small caps labels, the menu and buttons
tokens.--color-bg: safety orange — the polythene the whole page is printed on; also the type knocked out of solid blocks
tokens.--color-text: the one ink — text, headings, the impact figure, the distress-signal bars, the Donate block and the get-involved panel
tokens.--color-muted: thinner ink for prompts, dates, the signal caption and the footer lines
tokens.--color-seam: the flat of the heat-welded seam, the page's only rule
tokens.--color-seam-ridge: the ridges and edges of the seam, and the lines between table rows
tokens.--color-photo: the ground a photograph is printed onto in the one ink
tokens.--measure: maximum width of a column of body text
tokens.--gutter: space at the left and right edge of the page, and inside the get-involved panel
tokens.--seam: width of the heat-welded seam; list and table rules are thinner fractions of it
tokens.--bar: width of one bar of the distress signal, and of the gap between bars
tokens.--focus-ring: thickness of the keyboard focus ring and of the line under the current menu entry
tokens.--tap-target: minimum height of links in the menu, buttons and other tap targets
